mapper.select: SELECT mbr_acct_idx FROM tb_mbr_acct WHERE mbr_acct_idx = #{owner} AND del_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT lf_daily_uuid AS uuid, mbr_acct_idx, ttl, start_dt, end_dt FROM tb_lf_daily WHERE mbr_acct_idx = #{owner} AND del_at IS NULL AND start_dt <= #{end} AND (end_dt IS NULL OR end_dt >= #{start}) ORDER BY created_at, lf_daily_idx

SELECT t.lf_daily_uuid AS item_uuid, c.check_dt FROM tb_lf_daily_check c JOIN tb_lf_daily t ON t.lf_daily_idx = c.lf_daily_idx AND t.mbr_acct_idx = c.mbr_acct_idx WHERE t.mbr_acct_idx = #{owner} AND t.del_at IS NULL AND c.del_at IS NULL AND c.check_dt BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND c.check_dt >= t.start_dt AND (t.end_dt IS NULL OR c.check_dt <= t.end_dt) ORDER BY c.check_dt, t.lf_daily_idx
SELECT lf_daily_uuid AS uuid, mbr_acct_idx, ttl, start_dt, end_dt FROM tb_lf_daily WHERE mbr_acct_idx = #{owner} AND lf_daily_uuid = CAST(#{uuid} AS uuid) AND del_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_lf_daily (lf_daily_uuid, mbr_acct_idx, ttl, start_dt, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (CAST(#{uuid} AS uuid), #{mbrAcctIdx}, #{ttl}, #{startDt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_lf_daily SET ttl = #{title}, updated_by = #{loginId}, updated_at = now() WHERE mbr_acct_idx = #{owner} AND lf_daily_uuid = CAST(#{uuid} AS uuid) AND del_at IS NULL AND end_dt IS NULL
UPDATE tb_lf_daily SET del_at = now(), updated_by = #{loginId}, updated_at = now() WHERE mbr_acct_idx = #{owner} AND lf_daily_uuid = CAST(#{uuid} AS uuid) AND del_at IS NULL
UPDATE tb_lf_daily SET end_dt = #{today}, updated_by = #{loginId}, updated_at = now() WHERE mbr_acct_idx = #{owner} AND lf_daily_uuid = CAST(#{uuid} AS uuid) AND del_at IS NULL AND end_dt IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_lf_daily_check (lf_daily_idx, mbr_acct_idx, check_dt, created_by, updated_by, del_at) SELECT lf_daily_idx, mbr_acct_idx, #{date}, #{loginId}, #{loginId}, CASE WHEN #{completed} THEN NULL ELSE now() END FROM tb_lf_daily WHERE mbr_acct_idx = #{owner} AND lf_daily_uuid = CAST(#{uuid} AS uuid) AND del_at IS NULL AND start_dt <= #{date} AND (end_dt IS NULL OR end_dt >= #{date}) ON CONFLICT (lf_daily_idx, check_dt) DO UPDATE SET del_at = EXCLUDED.del_at, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_at = now()
